scope: Integrated temporary terrain and forest; scripted public edit calls and stepped travel without waiting for destination residency; four controlled workloads and recovery. Separate original/return control site. Does not test furnished cities, entities, multiplayer, physical input latency, or hour-long endurance. 20 ms frame gate is a regression tolerance, not proof of strict 60 FPS or headroom.
